quick_brief: Week 3 Challenge: Test your knowledge on how to safely navigate between multiple application screens, verify passwords and save data locally in TinyDB!

questions.text: What is the correct block in the Control section to navigate and open a new screen in the application?
What is the appropriate input box for writing secret numbers so that they appear as black dots to protect the user’s privacy?
Which local database do we use to permanently save student data (such as his name and age) within the phone’s memory?
What is the building block used to store a specific value in the TinyDB database under a specific tag?
When calling call TinyDB1.GetValue, what is the function of the valueIfTagNotThere entry?
options: Specify the value that will be permanently saved on the server
Specify the default value that will be returned if we do not find this tag previously saved
questions.correct: Specify the default value that will be returned if we do not find this tag previously saved

questions.text: Which Logical Block do we use to check that both the email and password match at the same time?
What is the programming event that is automatically executed once the screen opens and the application starts to format and view data?
How do we close the current screen and automatically return to the previous screen?
options: Change the Visible property to False

questions.text: In the code: call TinyDB1.StoreValue(tag="score", valueToStore=100), what is the tag here?
Which condition do we use to execute certain blocks if the data is true, and other alternate blocks if the data is false?
Type the verification code: If the text in TextBox1 equals 'megaminds' then open a screen called 'AdminScreen'.
questions.correct_code:
if get TextBox1.Text = "megaminds"
then call open another screen (screenName = "AdminScreen")

questions.text: Write the code to save the student's grades stored in a variable named global_points inside the TinyDB1 database with the tag 'student_points'.
